card.name: The word human in environment texts
card.fires_on: The word "human" or "humans" in environmental or ecology writing, often right after "and" or "of" in lists. It comes just before nouns like health, activity, population or settlements.

modes.label: Human health beside environment
modes.description: "Human" before "health" in lists about oceans, forests or ecosystems.

modes.label: Human impact on nature
modes.description: "Human" or "humans" naming people as a force on land, wildlife or climate.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "human" when the text is about people and the natural environment.
